assessment: Operator evidence assessment; no physical PASS inferred from simulation
production_requirement: All six gates PASS; F must be qualified on representative non-production hardware before production

gates.missing: Bootloader version/image/capabilities and reliable entry without application execution are missing.
gates.software_next: Identify supplied bootloader/monitor documentation and exact host build.
gates.physical_next: Capture identity read-only; subsequently demonstrate hardware entry on an authorized engineering unit.
gates.consequence: Broken application may remove the only USB update path.

gates.missing: Actual BOOTPROT/BPDIS/security/locks and version-specific erase/offset/verify scope are unknown.
gates.software_next: Inspect version-matched BOSSA source and apfw2 flash/linker manifests.
gates.physical_next: Read protection/geometry; qualify bounded writes and sentinel preservation on a sacrificial equivalent.
gates.consequence: Wrong erase or protection operation can destroy bootloader or state.

gates.missing: No unit-bound original full flash/bootloader/state backup, installed-version match or physical restoration proof.
gates.software_next: Preserve image identities and separate code-versus-state readback manifests.
gates.physical_next: Identify unit and region; capture duplicate consistent backups and test restoration.
gates.consequence: Vendor application may be wrong for the unit or insufficient after wider corruption.

gates.missing: Configuration overlaps application; live backups and apfw2-compatible partition/schema contract are absent.
gates.software_next: Compare actual apfw2 map, erase behavior and versioned data contract.
gates.physical_next: Back up complete readable device/state/fuse/calibration evidence and verify same-board restoration.
gates.consequence: Settings may be lost or restored into replacement code; downgraded behavior may be unsafe.

gates.missing: Accessible SWD/reset routing, voltage, security access and independent recovery procedure are unverified.
gates.software_next: Prepare a board-specific offline recovery manifest and compatible probe procedure.
gates.physical_next: Verify routing unpowered, then authorized read-only attach and app-independent recovery on engineering hardware.
gates.consequence: USB loss may make unit unrecoverable; destructive unlock may erase the only original state.

gates.missing: No qualified apfw2 release or physical upgrade/downgrade/interruption recovery demonstration.
gates.software_next: Supply release hash/map and approve an interruption/rollback test plan.
gates.physical_next: Perform controlled round trip and representative interrupted-update recovery on non-production hardware after A-E closure.
gates.consequence: Normal update success would leave failure recovery and downgrade unproven.
